title: DC-area forecast: Mild tonight with patchy fog by dawn; rain chance rises late Saturday
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Mostly to partly clear this evening as temperatures slowly fall through the 70s. Clouds increase again overnight but remaining dry.

What's next? A few spotty showers possible Saturday until a better chance of scattered showers and a storm by late afternoon or evening. Some improvement Sunday, with comfortable weather settling in Monday and Tuesday.

Forecast in detail

Tonight: Partly cloudy and mild, with clouds increasing after midnight and toward dawn. Lows dip to the 60s or around 70 downtown. Some patchy fog may develop as the temperature nears the dewpoint. Confidence: Medium

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Saturday: Quite cloudy with only a few spotty showers possible, until the odds for scattered showers and a storm rise after 3 or 4 p.m. Afternoon highs shoot mainly for the upper 70s to low 80s. Confidence: Medium

Saturday night: Scattered showers become likely after 7 or 8 p.m., with a few thunderstorms possible. The heaviest and most widespread may favor the overnight, then tapering to a lingering shower chance by dawn. Very muggy with lows near 70 to the mid-70s. Confidence: Medium

Sunday: A shower could linger early. Otherwise turning sunnier through midday and afternoon with highs reaching the low and mid-80s. Perhaps an additional late-day shower or storm, mainly east and south of DC. Confidence: Medium

A look ahead

Sunday night: Partly cloudy with a slow decrease in humidity. Lows in the mid-60s to low 70s. Confidence: Medium

A nicer stretch Monday and Tuesday. There could be a passing shower Monday with a weak front, then mostly sunny skies, low humidity, and highs in the upper 70s to mid-80s. Comfortably cool overnight lows in the mid-50s to mid-60s. Confidence: Low-Medium

Temperatures trend back up by Wednesday and Thursday, with highs potentially climbing to the upper 80s to near 90 both days. Humidity slowly increases again. There's also a slight chance of a shower or storm creeping back in. Confidence: Low-Medium

DC weather history for September 11

Striking contrasts define this date, from record heat in 1983 to record early-season chill in 1917, while in 2001 it was a clear, calm day overshadowed by historic tragedy.

Today’s daily digit — 6/10: Cooler and more comfortable, but a lingering early shower, humidity, and plentiful clouds keep it from being a standout. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

Dan Stillman contributed to the forecast.
